shared_elements: relief carving of a single principal figure
patterned surface detail rendered as rows of small repeated units
justification: Both show a single human figure in profile in relief, wearing a distinctive headdress and adornment, with detail rendered as repeated small incised units (curled beard rows versus beaded/scaled ornament). But A is a close bust portrait with a plain uncluttered ground and naturalistic, restrained modelling, while B is a full standing figure engulfed in dense interlocking ornament, serpentine/zoomorphic masks and glyph-like blocks filling the whole field — very different compositional and stylistic conventions.
